summary: @ornikar/webpack-config 12.0.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: Version 12.0.2 of this webpack configuration package adds a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (`_0x...` style) and downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into an OS temp directory, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style blob (string-array rotation with `push(shift())`, custom charset decoder, hex-encoded identifiers) with no webpack-related surface. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based tooling and grants full host access at install time. The release also diverges from the documented package history: CHANGELOG.md ends at 12.0.1 (routine webpack/linaria/node bumps); 12.0.2 introduces the preinstall, setup.mjs, and math_init.js, and the declared `main: index.js` is absent from the tarball, so the package is non-functional as a library. Structural shape is consistent with a hijacked maintainer release rather than legitimate package evolution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
